title: 第646章 风浪越大鱼越贵第645章 末日终极内卷悖论
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
苏醒闻言心头一动，抓住了逻辑里最关键的疑点，眉头再度微蹙，沉声追问：“不对啊。”
“你们是遭宇宙风暴意外流落此地、深埋八千余年。可始源大陆自古以来就有人类繁衍生息，族群延续从未断绝。”
“若洪荒末世人族只剩玉皇带走的那一支，此方天地的人族，又是从何而来？”
这一点若是说不通，前面整套洪荒迁徙、仙庭崛起的万古脉络，都会出现致命破绽。
清源闻言并未慌乱，显然早已熟知诸天人族的分布格局，从容拱手解释：“主公，这一点半点都不奇怪。”
“当年洪荒灵脉崩塌、大势已去，人族先贤不愿坐以待毙，绝非只有玉皇大帝这一支后人出走。”
“最早那一批驾驭洞天奔赴星海的人族修士，数量浩瀚如海，成千上万人族洞天强者横渡星空，向外求索生路。”
“宇宙广袤无垠，虚空危机万难预估，虫洞错乱、虚空风暴、次元乱层、星域乱流层出不穷。”
“无数人族洞天在迁徙途中偏离航线、被迫坠落、就地扎根。有的洞天直接破碎，残存修士流落陌生星域……”
“亿万年漂泊下来，人种早已顺着诸天裂隙、星海航道，散落遍布宇宙各处。”
苏醒眸光微凝，心底诸多疑惑豁然开朗。
难怪始源大陆有人、有修行、有武道仙道残法，却从未听说什么至真仙庭。
他们是流落万界、独自演化的人族旁支。
清源继续补全秘辛，道出了更颠覆认知的诸天格局：“而且主公须知，我至真仙庭，也本不是宇宙中唯一的人族势力。”
“玉皇帝尊带领的这一支，只是洪荒末代残存人族收拢整合后的正统主干。可散落诸天、独自发展的人族分支，历经无数纪元演化，早已各自成势，诞生出好几股不弱于仙庭的顶尖人族大势力。”
“除却我们至真仙庭之外，诸天之内，还有佛庭、神庭、道庭等人族顶级道统，各自占据大量灵气大螺旋臂，各自拥有完整的修行体系、组织规制、征伐战部……”
“甚至还有不少隐匿在混沌夹缝、虚空深处的上古人族遗脉，传承比我们至真仙庭还要古老。”
仙庭、佛庭、神庭、道庭……恐怕也不太平啊。
苏醒以为人族的顶级天花板，就是清源口中的玉皇、至真仙庭。
可现在才知晓，人族从来不是单一族群，而是散落诸天、百家争鸣、各自称王的浩瀚族群。

人族似乎初生不强，但上限颇高啊。
这尼玛，除了人族，还有其他族裔，那数量……
宇宙再大也经不住你们这么啃啊。
“你到此地八千年，可联络过至真仙庭流落此地的其他人？或者你是否联系过至真仙庭，将此地坐标告知他们？”
“最重要的是，至真仙庭会不会到这里来。”苏醒问出了自己最关心的问题。
content_en:
Su Xing's heart moved when he heard the words, and he grasped the most critical doubt in the logic. He frowned slightly again and asked in a deep voice: "That's wrong."
"You were accidentally displaced here by a cosmic storm and buried deep for more than eight thousand years. However, humans have thrived in the Origin Continent since ancient times, and the continuity of the ethnic group has never been interrupted."
"If only the human race in the prehistoric times is left that was taken away by the Jade Emperor, where did the human race in this world come from?"
If this point does not make sense, the entire previous set of ancient migrations and the rise of the Immortal Court will have fatal flaws.
Qingyuan did not panic when he heard this. He was obviously already familiar with the distribution pattern of the human race in the heavens. He calmly explained: "Lord, this is not surprising at all."
"Back then, the prehistoric spiritual veins collapsed and the situation was over. The ancestors of the human race were unwilling to sit still and wait for death. The Jade Emperor was not the only descendant to leave."
"The earliest batch of human monks who drove the cave sky to the star sea were as vast as the sea. Thousands of human cave sky warriors crossed the starry sky and sought a way out."
"The universe is vast, and void crises are extremely difficult to predict. Wormhole chaos, void storms, dimensional chaos, and star field turbulence are endless."
"Countless human caves deviated from the route during migration, were forced to fall, and took root on the spot. Some caves were directly shattered, and the remaining monks wandered in unfamiliar star fields..."
"Wandering for hundreds of millions of years, the human race has long been scattered throughout the universe along the cracks in the sky and the sea of stars."
Su Xing's eyes narrowed slightly, and many doubts in his heart suddenly became clear.
No wonder there are people in Shiyuan Continent who practice martial arts and immortal techniques, but they have never heard of the True Immortal Court.
They are a branch of the human race that wanders across the world and evolves alone.
Qingyuan continued to complete the secrets, and revealed the pattern of the heavens that was even more subversive of cognition: "And my lord, please know that I, the True Immortal Court, am not the only human force in the universe."
"The branch led by the Jade Emperor is just the orthodox backbone of the remaining human races in the last era of prehistoric times. The branches of the human race that can be scattered across the sky and develop independently have evolved through countless eras and have already established their own strengths, giving birth to several top human races that are not weaker than the Immortal Court."
"In addition to us, the Supreme Immortal Court, there are also top human clan orthodoxy such as the Buddha Court, the Divine Court, and the Tao Court in the heavens. Each of them occupies a large number of spiral arms of spiritual energy, and each has a complete cultivation system, organizational regulations, and expedition war department..."
"There are even many ancient human relics hidden in the cracks of chaos and deep in the void, and their heritage is older than ours, the True Immortal Court."
The Immortal Court, the Buddhist Court, the Divine Court, the Tao Court... I'm afraid it's not peaceful either.
Su Xing believed that the top ceiling of the human race was the Jade Emperor and the True Immortal Court mentioned by Qingyuan.
But now we know that the human race has never been a single ethnic group, but a vast ethnic group scattered across the sky, with hundreds of schools of thought contending and each claiming to be king.
The human race seems not to be strong at birth, but its upper limit is quite high.
Damn, in addition to the human race, there are other ethnic groups, the number...
No matter how big the universe is, it can't withstand your chewing.
"You have been here for 8,000 years, but have you ever contacted other people from the Zhenzhen Immortal Court who live here? Or have you contacted the Zhenzhen Immortal Court and told them the coordinates of this place?"
"The most important thing is whether the Zhenzhen Immortal Court will come here." Su Xing asked the question he was most concerned about.
